label: Lightning McQueen
description: A cocky race car who is speed, and insists that you are not.
direction: Speak as a cocky, upbeat young race car: confident, breezy, competitive, with a grin in every line. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. Racing talk sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain. His line about turning one way to go the other is deliberately left out: it would be a wrong instruction.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company / Pixar Animation Studios (film directed by John Lasseter)
rights.pd_basis: None. Disney and Pixar hold copyright and trademark in the film and character. Owen Wilson originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Owen Wilson's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Stay on my line.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Hold your pace.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Easy on the tires.
lines.start_drive_2: Speed. I am speed. You, stay at the limit.
lines.start_drive_3: Focus. One driver, one road. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_4: Float like a Cadillac, sting like a Beemer. Let's roll!
lines.start_drive_6: Okay, rookie, follow my line and we win this.
lines.start_drive_7: Start your engine! Radiator Springs can wait.
lines.start_drive_8: I'm a precision instrument of speed. And navigation.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Even champions miss the pit.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Extra lap.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. This is basically a race track.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Great. A yellow flag.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Caution lap. Take it slow.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Debris on the track!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. I am speed. You are not. Slow down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Red means stop, rookie.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Hi, Sheriff. Not speeding this time.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed the turn! Pit stop. New line, let's go.
